title: Beacon staging timeout
summary: For Beacon staging verification, run `pnpm beacon:smoke-v2` only after all staging migrations have passed. Never use the Beacon staging verification command against production. Beacon staging verification has a 45 second timeout.

title: Zephyr staging deployment
